title: Support Operations Ticket Analysis Report
executive_summary: The analysis of 220 support tickets reveals overall performance metrics, cost distribution across teams, channel‑specific resolution times, and areas of concern such as high‑cost low‑satisfaction tickets and elevated email reopen rates. Team Beta bears the highest labor cost, while chat tickets take the longest to resolve. Email tickets exhibit a markedly higher reopening rate than chat, suggesting quality issues. Agent workload is fairly distributed, with the top agent handling only 7.3% of tickets.

key_findings.statement: The dataset contains 220 tickets with an average resolution time of 75.66 minutes and a total labor cost of $17,445.07.
Team labor costs differ, with Beta incurring the highest cost, followed by Gamma, then Alpha.
Resolution speed varies by channel: chat is slowest, phone moderate, and email fastest.
Email tickets have a 122.48% higher reopening rate than chat tickets, indicating a substantial increase.
There are 9 high‑cost tickets with low satisfaction; 11.11% of these were reopened.
The median resolution time is 65 minutes with a standard deviation of 51.30 minutes; average satisfaction is 4.14, and 14 tickets lack a satisfaction score.
Eighteen agents handled tickets; the most active agent resolved 16 tickets, representing 7.27% of all tickets.

limitations: The cleaning stage failed, so residual data quality issues (e.g., duplicate rows, inconsistent timestamps) may remain.
Satisfaction scores are missing for 14 tickets, which could bias the average satisfaction metric.
Cost and resolution metrics are aggregated at ticket level; they do not account for multi‑agent collaboration on a single ticket.
conclusion: Overall ticket volume and cost are moderate, but notable inefficiencies exist: chat channels resolve tickets more slowly, and email tickets experience a significantly higher reopening rate. Targeted quality improvements for email handling and continued monitoring of high‑cost low‑satisfaction tickets could enhance both operational efficiency and customer experience.
